prompt:
# Complete Updated Screener Specification

Screen active NIFTY 200 members only on the completed 09:15 IST 5-minute candle for either a short or a long setup. All conditions within a setup must hold.

Short: high(t0) > SMA20(t0), SMA50(t0), SMA200(t0); close(t0) < all three SMAs.

Long: close(t0) > open(t0); open(t0) < SMA20(t0), SMA50(t0), SMA200(t0) and close(t0) > all three SMAs; volume(t0) > volume(t-1).

Both setups require previous SuperTrend between the current candle's low and high, inclusive. Use the stored platform defaults: SMA20 (20), SMA50 (50), SMA200 (200), and SuperTrend (period 10, multiplier 3).

If multiple stocks match at 09:15 IST, retain only the highest-liquidity stock across both setups. Liquidity is average daily volume / (1 + average daily relative range), using the preceding liquidity_days trading sessions (default 10), excluding the signal day. Later candles are never eligible. Return at most one qualifying stock per date, breaking liquidity ties by signal volume, then symbol. Dates without an opening qualifier return no row. Total counts selected daily winners.

The default date range is the latest 60 trading sessions, processed date by date. Accept inclusive from_date/to_date, at most 90 calendar days, as_of replay (IST candle OPEN timestamp), and comma-separated symbols intersected with live NIFTY 200. Replay includes the target candle after completion, never later OPEN timestamps; live scans exclude unfinished candles. Existing limit (1-10) and sort overrides remain accepted but cannot change the daily liquidity winner.

Present a flat table with Symbol, Date, Last price (LTP), Volume, Candle time, Avg volume (20), SMA 20, SMA 50, SMA 200, and SuperTrend. Disable date grouping and date chips via presentation group_by_date: false and date_chips: false; retain the top date-range filter. Order dates descending. Limit to one row per date with numbered pagination (10 rows per page), symbol search, and sortable columns.

Acceptance loads the unchanged chart-evidence/cbcf05d6839f/acceptance_cases.json fixture against real history: COLPAL must match 2026-10-30 09:15 IST and BAJFINANCE must match 2026-10-13 09:15 IST on interval 5. Record measured conditions and actual rows in ACCEPTANCE_REPORT_PATH (default acceptance_report.json); never special-case symbols or dates.
